Text.Text: The Vortex Training Engine is offline. Now the engineers can reach the drive assemblies. You found your center under pressure; come here and I will show you how to carry that control into Saber Cyclone.
I only take someone who has mastered the saberstaff. When both ends of the staff answer you without thought, come back and we will talk about the work on Dantooine.

The Jedi Enclave Trial Halls on Dantooine are sealed. A cyclone droid cut through a stair railing before we closed them. Everyone got out; the machines stayed, repeating the last drill at full power. Disable six Cyclone Drill Droids and recover the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate.
Take this key. It opens the sealed passage a few steps inside the Jedi Enclave Library on Dantooine. Disable six Cyclone Drill Droids and bring me the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate.
The cyclone is one continuous motion. Your center stays under your control while both ends of the staff work around it.

From the Colony Central landing on Dantooine, go north through the Wild Plains to the Medical Safehouse, follow the Hidden Trail to the Enclosed Mountain, and enter the Jedi Enclave. The sealed passage is a few steps inside the Library. I stay in Tochee because the war has eyes on those ruins, and an Enclave examiner walking into them would bring that trouble down on you.
Duelist constructs with rotary combat routines. They imitate our forms through motors and targeting software. You are dismantling faulty equipment, not fighting other students.
Six Cyclone Drill Droids, and the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate. The passage is inside the Enclave Library on Dantooine.
You have the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate. Let me see it.
The slate records the shutdown failures. The next controller is deeper inside.

The first drills are down. Their timing controller still drives the next set of machines. Disable five Cyclone Duelist Droids deeper in the Trial Halls and recover the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard.
Five Cyclone Duelist Droids, deeper in the Trial Halls. Bring back the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard.
The next units react to each other. Bait one attack, move out of its partner's line, then close before their routines synchronize again.
The Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard belongs to the training array. It helps coordinate the practice emitters; return it so the technicians can trace the fault.
Past the halls you already cleared, deeper in. Keep a way back to the Library passage.
Five Cyclone Duelist Droids, deeper in the Trial Halls. Bring back the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard.
You brought the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The focus shard is secure. We can now work on the sealed gate.

One gate runs on its own controller, and the remote shutdown still cannot reach it. A Cyclone Gatekeeper Droid guards the approach to the Saber Trial Chamber at the north end of the halls. Disable it and recover the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
The Cyclone Gatekeeper Droid guards the approach to the Saber Trial Chamber. Disable it and recover the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
The Cyclone Gatekeeper Droid is a reinforced gate-control construct. Its shutdown channel is broken, so the chassis must be disabled directly.
The Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil is the damaged authorization plate from that gate. Recover it so we can restore the lock without reactivating its defender.
Three fighters can divide its attention and cover a retreat. This is damaged equipment operating at lethal output; do not treat it as a practice duel.
The Cyclone Gatekeeper Droid still guards the approach to the Saber Trial Chamber. Disable it and recover the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
You brought the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The gate is clear. The sigil will let us identify the remaining control seals.
The gate is open, but four linked Cyclone Examiner Droids still guard the network's control systems. Disable all four and recover the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit.
Four Cyclone Examiner Droids guard the control systems in the Trial Halls. Disable them and recover the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit.
The Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit authorizes service access to the training network. With it, the instructors can get back into their own halls.
The four constructs share targeting data. Break their formation before they can concentrate every attack on one of you.
Their routines were built from recorded exercises. The engineers can rebuild the machinery once you have made the wing safe.
Four Cyclone Examiner Droids still guard the control systems in the Trial Halls. Disable them and recover the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit.
You brought the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The chit is secure. One chamber remains.

Only the central training engine remains, and while it runs it can restart every damaged routine. The Vortex Training Engine waits in the Saber Trial Chamber, through the door at the north end of the halls. Disable it. Bring at least two allies.
The Vortex Training Engine waits in the Saber Trial Chamber at the north end of the Trial Halls. Disable it, and bring at least two allies.
The Vortex Training Engine coordinates this branch of the training network. Its adaptive combat routines let it direct several attackers at once.
Stay close enough to help each other without offering it one easy line of attack. Trade the pressure between you and keep the escape route open.
The hall will stay sealed until the engineers replace the faulty controllers and test every shutdown. Nobody will be sent back into ordinary lessons while these faults remain.
The Vortex Training Engine still waits in the Saber Trial Chamber at the north end of the Trial Halls. Disable it, and bring at least two allies.
The Vortex Training Engine is down. Tell me what happened.

The Vortex Training Engine is offline. Now the engineers can reach the drive assemblies. You found your center under pressure; come here and I will show you how to carry that control into Saber Cyclone.

Tochee on Tatooine is far enough from the Enclave for visitors to speak freely. I teach control of a saberstaff, not obedience to a gate guard. The damaged halls are the Jedi Enclave Trial Halls on Dantooine. Take the key there, and return to me in Tochee after the drill.
Go over the first assignment.
I will shut down the first drills.
What does this discipline teach?
Where do I go, and why are you staying here?
Who or what will I be fighting?
I need to prepare first.
Here is the recovered slate.
Go over the next objective.
I will recover the focus shard.
What should I know before going deeper?
What is the focus shard?
Where is the next group?
I need more time.
Here is the focus shard.
Explain the gate assignment again.
I will bring two allies and clear the breach.
What guards the gate?
Why recover the broken sigil?
Why bring a group?
I will gather my companions first.
The gate is clear. Here is the sigil.
Go over the four targets again.
I will disable the examiners.
What does the trial chit do?
How do they work together?
Can the machines be repaired?
I need to rest first.
Here is the trial chit.
Go over the final objective.
We will go in together.
What is waiting in the last chamber?
How should we fight it?
What happens after this?
My companions need to prepare.
The training engine is down. We made it out.
Why are we meeting here, and where is the trial?
Back to the assignment.
